verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics physics simulator with no AI or LLM component that could consume tools. Acting as an MCP client, plugging in MCP servers so an agent can call their tools, is a category error for this kind of product. Its C++ simulation and GUI plugins and its gz-transport messaging are unrelated extension mechanisms and do not make the MCP-client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
